sentences.content: Do you know what a resolution is?
sentences.english: Do you know what a resolution is ?
sentences.chinese: 你知道什么是决心吗？

sentences.content: A resolution is a promise that you make to yourself.
sentences.english: A resolution is a promise that you make to yourself
sentences.chinese: 决心是你对自己许下的承诺。

wordDetails.definition: be（第三人称单数现在时）: 是
那个（关系代词，引导定语从句）

sentences.content: People make resolutions to improve their life.
sentences.english: People make resolutions to improve their life
sentences.chinese: 人们制定决心以改善生活。

sentences.content: The most common kind is a New Year’s resolution.
sentences.english: The most common kind is a New Year's resolution
sentences.chinese: 最常见的一种是新年决心。

sentences.content: Resolutions can be about anything.
sentences.english: Resolutions can be about anything
sentences.chinese: 决心可以关乎任何事情。

sentences.content: Some are about physical health.
sentences.english: Some are about physical health
sentences.chinese: 有些是关于身体健康的。

sentences.content: For example, some people may promise to exercise more or eat more healthily.
sentences.english: For example , some people may promise to exercise more or eat more healthily
sentences.chinese: 例如，有些人可能会承诺多锻炼或饮食更健康。

sentences.content: Some resolutions have to do with learning new things.
sentences.english: Some resolutions have to do with learning new things
sentences.chinese: 有些决心与学习新事物有关。

sentences.content: People might decide they are going to take up a hobby, like painting or photography.
sentences.english: People might decide they are going to take up a hobby , like painting or photography
sentences.chinese: 人们可能会决定培养一种爱好，比如绘画或摄影。

sentences.content: And some resolutions have to do with self-improvement,
sentences.english: And some resolutions have to do with self-improvement
sentences.chinese: 而有些决心则与自我提升有关，

sentences.content: like becoming more confident or organized.
sentences.english: like becoming more confident or organized
sentences.chinese: 比如变得更加自信或有条理。

sentences.content: Although there are differences,
sentences.english: Although there are differences
sentences.chinese: 尽管存在差异，

sentences.content: most resolutions have one thing in common:
sentences.english: most resolutions have one thing in common :
sentences.chinese: 大多数新年决心都有一个共同点：

sentences.content: people hardly ever keep them!
sentences.english: people hardly ever keep them !
sentences.chinese: 人们几乎从不保留它们！

sentences.content: But there are good reasons for this.
sentences.english: But there are good reasons for this
sentences.chinese: 但这有其充分的理由。

sentences.content: Sometimes the resolutions may be too difficult to keep.
sentences.english: Sometimes the resolutions may be too difficult to keep
sentences.chinese: 有时这些决心可能太难坚持。

sentences.content: And sometimes people just forget about them.
sentences.english: And sometimes people just forget about them
sentences.chinese: 而有时人们只是忘记了它们。

sentences.content: To make your resolutions work, you need to plan them wisely.
sentences.english: To make your resolutions work , you need to plan them wisely
sentences.chinese: 要让你的决心奏效，你需要明智地规划它们。

sentences.content: Always make sure your resolution is possible to achieve.
sentences.english: Always make sure your resolution is possible to achieve
sentences.chinese: 始终确保你的目标是可以实现的。

sentences.content: Don’t set a goal that is too difficult or too much for you.
sentences.english: Don't set a goal that is too difficult or too much for you
sentences.chinese: 不要给自己设定过于困难或力所不及的目标。

wordDetails.definition: 关系代词（引导定语从句）

sentences.content: Try to set mini-goals to help you achieve your resolution.
sentences.english: Try to set mini-goals to help you achieve your resolution
sentences.chinese: 尝试设定小目标来帮助你实现决心。

sentences.content: And if you don’t want to forget your resolutions, write them down.
sentences.english: And if you don't want to forget your resolutions , write them down
sentences.chinese: 若不想忘记自己的决心，不妨将其写下来。

sentences.content: Also, talk about them with your family and friends.
sentences.english: Also , talk about them with your family and friends
sentences.chinese: 此外，与你的家人和朋友聊聊他们。

sentences.content: Encourage them to remind you of your goals.
sentences.english: Encourage them to remind you of your goals
sentences.chinese: 鼓励他们提醒你记住自己的目标。

sentences.content: So what resolutions are you going to make?
sentences.english: So what resolutions are you going to make ?
sentences.chinese: 那么你打算制定什么新年计划呢？

wordDetails.definition: are（现在时）: 构成现在进行时

sentences.content: How are you going to keep them?
sentences.english: How are you going to keep them ?
sentences.chinese: 你打算怎么留住他们？
